plugins.name: skill-forge
plugins.description: Auto-distill reusable skills after multi-step tasks, and keep the skill library fresh and within budget.

plugins.name: memory-loop
plugins.description: Close the memory loop: consume hook-written memory candidates, split them per project, and re-inject distilled memory at session start.

plugins.name: project-guardrails
plugins.description: Per-project guardrails on a user-level plugin. Zero-config by default: a repo with a handoff ledger carrier gets the ledger index + doc-size budget injected at SessionStart (convention over configuration). Declare `context`, tool rules and `entrypoints` in <repo>/.agents/guardrails.json (fallback .zcode/) to override or to turn it off.

plugins.name: impeccable
plugins.description: Design fluency for frontend work, vendored from upstream impeccable for ZCode: the impeccable skill (24 design verbs), a /impeccable command router, and a PostToolUse design hook that scans edited UI files.

plugins.name: taste-skill
plugins.description: Anti-slop frontend builds for ZCode, vendored from upstream taste-skill: the design-taste-frontend skill (deal-driven palettes/type/layouts, real photos and product UI, real-browser checker), a /taste-skill command router, and a Stop finish-gate hook that holds the session until the armed build passes.
